evidence.quote: Help Scout is a shared inbox platform built for email-first support teams. It uses a Gmail-like interface instead of numbered tickets, built around three core components: Inbox for shared email. Docs for knowledge base, and. Beacon for an embeddable help widget.
This is an https-only api, with oauth 2 authentication and cors support running at: https://api.helpscout.net/v2

It's also important to note that Help Scout offers a 15-day free trial with access to all features, allowing teams to evaluate the platform before committing.

To generate, view, or regenerate the api key, click your avatar in the top right of your account, then click your profile . next, click security and access in the menu on the left. your api key is listed under the docs api section.

*   **Correction**: No correction needed.
